quest.title: Give It Up!
quest.description: Sayu has been discovered by Kano Nana, and has no choice but to return to Chinju Forest to practice ninjutsu. She begs you to come along, and so you do...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I can see that you're tired, but it's not good to neglect your work either.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Growing taller is what you really care about, isn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's not the amount of sleep but the quality of sleep that's keeping you from growing.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sleep alone isn't enough to make you grow taller.
